headline: Uzbekistan — Turkey Business Council: What did Shavkat Mirziyoyev, Saida Mirziyoyeva and Javdat Yilmaz say?
summary: At an Uzbekistan–Turkey business council meeting, President Mirziyoyev said both countries' doors are open to Turkish investment. Turkey's vice president said the council would open new investments and projects.
why: Bilateral business councils set the agenda for trade and foreign direct investment between countries, influencing which projects and deals advance.
original_headline: O‘zbekiston — Turkiya biznes kengashi: Shavkat Mirziyoyev, Saida Mirziyoyeva va Javdat Yilmaz nimalar dedi?
